'''Yuun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Breather Gand|breathing]] [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Findsman/Legends|findsman]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Technician/Legends|technical engineer]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Like many of his [[Species/Legends|species]], he referred to himself simply as '''Gand''' when he was ashamed. Recruited into [[Havoc Squad]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] at the beginning of the [[Galactic War]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Yuun served in the unit until his [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|commanding officer]] disappeared in [[3636 BBY]]; Yuun spent a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] unsuccessfully searching the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] for his commander before he left the Republic Military and began studying the technology of the [[Eternal Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] from his [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Gand (planet)/Legends|homeworld]], Yuun was trained as a [[Findsman/Legends|Findsman]] by the shamanistic order. A technical wizard, Yuun abandoned his homeworld in what he considered a logical decision to join the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] which followed the [[Great Galactic War]]. Training with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Yuun used his Findsman techniques to locate portents to rise through the ranks with a list of great accomplishes. As effective as Yuun's methods were, they were rarely met with understanding or approval from his fellow soldiers. But despite his eccentricities, Yuun's fighting skill and calm approach to any challenge generally earned at least the grudging respect of the men and women he served with.<ref name="TORE" />

===Joining Havoc Squad===
[[File:Yuun_Gand.png|left|thumb|Yuun during the Battle of the Gauntlet]]
Stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] as a member of [[Havoc Squad]] thanks to an appointment by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]], Yuun was assigned to take down the Imperial [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] [[Gauntlet (Sith Empire)|Gauntlet]]. Reassembling an Imperial device called the [[Black cipher|umbra encrypter]] to crack Imperial codes, Yuun was able to prove his worth to his colleagues and was welcomed to the squad.<ref name="TORE" />

===Joining the Alliance===
When Havoc Squad's commanding officer went missing during the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|invasion]], Havoc searched for their leader for a year before being disbanded, with [[Tanno Vik]] returning to a life of crime, [[M1-4X|Forex]] being called to serve in the [[Press Corps]], and [[Elara Dorne]] being removed from Havoc by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh|Saresh]]. Yuun ultimately left the military and traveled to [[Zakuul]] to try and understand Zakuulan technology. By [[3631 BBY]], Yuun was approached by [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]], acting on the advice of [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] for recruitment into the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] opposing the Eternal Empire. Yuun was in the process of reassembling a device that would [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloak]] the Alliance base on [[Odessen]] from the Eternal Empire's long-ranged sensors. He had already gathered the first seventeen pieces and requested the Outlander's help to recover the remaining three. The Outlander completed this task and the two left Zakuul for Odessen. Upon arriving, Yuun used his intuition to help Oggurobb locate a [[precision torque-spanner]] he lost months ago before pointing out a solution to a thruster heat dissipation problem the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] couldn't figure out for a month.<ref name="KOTFE" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the Imperial storyline, Yuun leaves the Alliance after ''Jedi Under Siege'' because of the Alliance's perceived newfound alignment with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and asked that this not be a cause for sorrow for the Commander. However, he left the possibility open to working with the Commander in the future should their paths converge once again.<ref name="Paths">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=message|Diverging Paths|Yuun}}</ref>
